---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

Describe the problem or frustration you are experiencing.

Explain how it affects your studying, note-taking, assignment management or workflow.

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

Explain how it would solve the problem.

## Student use case

Describe a real-world situation in which this feature would be useful.

For example, explain when you would use it during lectures, coursework, revision or assignment planning.

## Suggested behaviour

If relevant, describe how you imagine the feature working.

You may include a rough sketch, example workflow or screenshot.

## Affected platforms

Where would this feature be useful?

- [ ] Windows
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] iPadOS
- [ ] Android tablets
- [ ] All supported platforms

## Offline-first considerations

If applicable, explain whether the feature should work offline and how its changes should synchronise across devices.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternatives or workarounds you have already tried.

## Additional context

Add any further information that might help evaluate this request.

Feature requests are suggestions for discussion and are not guarantees of implementation.
